yt_description:
Still managing your vendors on a spreadsheet? Expired contracts. Late invoices. Zero compliance.

Stackby turns your spreadsheets into a real Vendor Portal: onboarding, compliance, contracts, POs and invoices — in one portal. Import your sheet, every row becomes a record, and your portal is live in minutes. Or just describe what you need and Stackby AI builds it.

👉 Build your vendor portal, free to start: https://stackby.com/signup

What's inside
• Vendor Onboarding
• Compliance & Documents

• Purchase Orders & Invoices

Why teams switch
✅ Self-serve vendor portal: vendors upload docs and invoices themselves.
✅ Always compliant: expiring documents flagged automatically.
✅ Spend visibility: every PO, invoice and contract — live.
✅ Vendor-only access: each vendor sees only their own records.
